plugin.name: Hanshuang Pojia
plugin.description: Statically triage APK, AAB, IPA, DEX, ELF, PE, Mach-O and archive samples: format, manifest facts, permissions, exported components, native hardening, embedded secrets and a scored report — no execution, no external toolchain.
skill.name: Hanshuang Pojia · Binary triage
skill.description: Statically audit an APK, IPA, DEX, ELF, PE or Mach-O file and explain what drives its risk score.
tab.label: Hanshuang Pojia
panel.rail.title: Samples in workspace
panel.rail.empty: No package or binary in this folder. Type a path below.
panel.rail.noCwd: No workspace folder is attached to this panel.
panel.rail.hint: Read-only inspection. Files are never executed or modified.
panel.header.subtitle: Static binary and package triage
panel.empty.title: Pick a sample to inspect
panel.empty.body: Choose a file on the left, or paste a path to an APK, IPA, DEX, shared library, executable or archive. The report covers format, manifest, native hardening and rule-based findings.
panel.intro.title: Pick a sample, then keep digging in chat
panel.intro.body: The list on the left comes from this project folder. Analysis only reads bytes — nothing is uploaded, unpacked or run.
panel.intro.bodyNoWorkspace: Open this panel from a project tab to see its files, or ask the agent in chat with a path inside the project.
panel.intro.scope: The engine reads project files up to 32 MiB each. Bigger or outside-the-project samples get handed to the agent in one click — the panel says which lane you are in.
panel.intro.step1.title: Choose a sample
panel.intro.step1.body: Click a file on the left, or paste a path. Paths the engine cannot read are flagged immediately.
panel.intro.step2.title: Read the verdict
panel.intro.step2.body: In-scope samples get a local report: score, matched rules with evidence, facts and declared limits.
panel.intro.step3.title: Follow up in chat
panel.intro.step3.body: Hand an oversized or out-of-project sample to the agent, or ask it to scan strings, explain a rule, or export the report.
panel.intro.prompts.title: Ask in chat
panel.intro.prompts.one: Triage build/app-release.apk and tell me what drives its risk score.
panel.intro.prompts.two: Which exported components and dangerous permissions does this APK expose?
panel.intro.prompts.three: Look for hardcoded keys or tokens inside this binary.
panel.intro.prompts.copied: Prompt copied — paste it into the chat input
panel.intro.prompts.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable — select the prompt text and copy it manually
panel.error.title: Analysis failed
panel.error.outsideProject: The host blocked this path: plugins may only read files inside the open project folder. Move the sample into the project — or open its folder as a project — and try again.
panel.error.outsideProjectDetail: {{path}} is outside the open project folder. The host only grants plugins access to files under {{root}}, so even "file not found" is unreachable here. Move the sample inside the project, or open its own folder as a project.
panel.error.hint: Every file in the list on the left is already inside the project — picking one avoids this limit entirely.
panel.error.tooLargeDetail: {{path}} is {{size}}, over the {{limit}} the host lets a plugin read in one binary file. The bytes never reach the engine, so this is a host limit, not a scan result.
panel.blocked.title: The engine cannot open this one
panel.blocked.why: The chat agent runs with the app's own file access, so it can hash, hexdump and scan strings on the real file whatever its size or location. The prompt below already names the file and the limits.
panel.blocked.noWorkspace: Open this panel from a project tab first — the agent needs a working folder to start a conversation.
panel.blocked.reason.tooLarge: bigger than the 32 MiB the plugin reader allows
panel.blocked.reason.outside: outside the project folder the plugin can read
panel.blocked.handoffSent: Handed to the agent — the answer continues in chat
panel.blocked.handoffOpened: Opened a conversation with this sample
panel.blocked.pathCopyFailed: Clipboard unavailable — select the path and copy it manually
panel.handoff.prompt: Triage {{path}} statically. It is {{reason}}, so the plugin's own reader cannot open it — use your shell tools instead: hash it, identify the container and its entries, pull the notable strings (URLs, hosts, script names, embedded executables) and report each conclusion with evidence plus what you could not see. Never execute the sample.
